label: FP
reason: User-provided header data is fully sanitized through multiple transformations (append, replace, Base64 encoding, split) before reaching the cookie value, resulting in a static safe value. The final cookie value derives from a cryptographically unsound RNG but lacks user control.

evidence.note: URL-decoded header param flows through doSomething() transformations
